claim: USDA FoodData Central data are public domain.
quote: USDA FoodData Central data are in the public domain and they are not copyrighted.

claim: Published under CC0 1.0.
quote: They are published under CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0)

claim: USDA requests, but does not require, that users credit FoodData Central.
quote: No permission is needed for their use, but we request that users list FoodData Central as the source of the data

claim: Each request carries a free data.gov API key.
quote: Anyone may access and use the API. However, a data.gov API key must be incorporated into each API request.

claim: The default limit is 1,000 requests per hour per IP address.
quote: FoodData Central currently limits the number of API requests to a default rate of 1,000 requests per hour per IP address, as this is adequate for most applications.

claim: Going over blocks the key for an hour.
quote: Exceeding this limit will cause the API key to be temporarily blocked for 1 hour.

claim: Higher limits on request.
quote: Contact FoodData Central if a higher request rate setting is needed.

claim: DEMO_KEY: 30 requests an hour and 50 a day per IP address.
quote: Hourly Limit: 30 requests per IP address per hour Daily Limit: 50 requests per IP address per day

claim: Two endpoints: Food Search and Food Details.
quote: The API provides two endpoints: the Food Search endpoint, which returns foods that match desired search criteria, and the Food Details endpoint, which returns details on a particular food.

claim: Keys found online are deactivated.
quote: Any API keys discovered online, such as those in a code repository, will be deactivated to prevent malicious use.

claim: Foundation Foods: analytical data on commodity and minimally processed food samples.
quote: Analytical data/metadata on commodity and minimally processed food samples.

claim: SR Legacy: historical data, final update 2018.
quote: Historical data derived from analyses, calculations, and published literature.

claim: SR Legacy's final update was in 2018.
quote: Updates: Final update was in 2018

claim: FNDDS analyzes foods reported in What We Eat in America, NHANES.
quote: Data applied to analyze foods/beverages reported in What We Eat in America, NHANES.

claim: Branded Foods: label data from a public-private partnership.
quote: Label data collected through a public-private partnership.

claim: FoodData Central also lists Experimental Foods.
quote: Data from foods published in peer-reviewed journals in collaboration with USDA.

claim: Release numbers and years change as new versions ship.
quote: Release numbers and years change as new versions are released.

claim: Managed by ARS's Beltsville Human Nutrition Research Center.
quote: FoodData Central is managed by the Agricultural Research Service's Beltsville Human Nutrition Research Center and hosted by the National Agricultural Library.

claim: Open Food Facts database under the ODbL.
quote: The Open Food Facts database is available under the Open Database License (ODbL)

claim: Contents under the DbCL.
quote: The individual contents of the database are available under the Database Contents License (DbCL)

claim: Images under CC-BY-SA.
quote: Products images are available under the Creative Commons Attribution ShareAlike licence (CC-BY-SA)

claim: Share-alike: an adapted database used publicly must be offered under the ODbL.
quote: If you publicly use any adapted version of this database, or works produced from an adapted database, you must also offer that adapted database under the ODbL

claim: Attribution of any public use.
quote: You must attribute any public use of the database, or works produced from the database, in the manner specified in the ODbL

claim: Open Food Facts provides its database and API free of charge.
quote: We provide our database and API 100% free of charge and open to all

claim: Production use as long as one API call is one real scan by a user.
quote: You are very welcome to use the API for production cases, as long as 1 API call = 1 real scan by a user.

claim: The product API is the one the Open Food Facts mobile app uses.
quote: A JSON API is also available to read the data for a product. This API is in particular used in the Open Food Facts mobile app.

claim: Heavier use goes to the bulk exports, not the API.
quote: Any attempt to scrape the database using the API will very likely be blocked, as full daily exports are available on this very page.

claim: Open Food Facts licences allow commercial use under conditions.
quote: The licences are free licences that authorize the use and reproduction of the content for all purposes, including commercial use, under certain conditions

claim: Open Food Facts does not guarantee accuracy.
quote: Open Food Facts does not guarantee the accuracy of the information and data present on the site and in the database

claim: Reads need only a custom User-Agent.
quote: READ operations (getting info about a product, etc...) do not require authentication other than the custom User-Agent.

claim: 15 product reads a minute per IP address.
quote: 15 req/min/IP address for all read product queries

claim: 10 searches a minute per IP address.
quote: 10 req/min/IP address for all search queries

claim: Limits apply per user when requests come from users' devices.
quote: If your requests come from your users directly (ex: mobile app), the rate limits apply per user.

claim: No assurance of accuracy for volunteer-provided data.
quote: As a result, there are no assurances that the data is accurate, complete, or reliable.

claim: Do not use search for search-as-you-type.
quote: don't use it for a search-as-you-type feature, you would be blocked very quickly.

claim: Open Food Facts asks every app to send a custom User-Agent identifying it.
quote: We ask you to always use a custom User-Agent to identify your app (to not risk being identified as a bot).

claim: The User-Agent takes the form AppName/Version (ContactEmail).
quote: The User-Agent should be in the form of AppName/Version (ContactEmail)

claim: It asks API users to fill in a usage form.
quote: fill out the API usage form so that we can identify your usage and prevent potential bans.

claim: Open Food Facts is migrating to Keycloak.
quote: Open Food Facts is migrating to Keycloak as its authentication system.

claim: wger logs calories with a food database from Open Food Facts.
quote: Log your calories with a food database
